title: Pullback square for scalar tensor representatives
statement: Let phi:A -> B be a homomorphism of commutative rings in Type(u+1), f:Z -> W a morphism of schemes in universe u, and P a cochain complex of A-module sheaves on W. Let q_phi(P) be the explicit scalar tensor representative [lem-pur-scalar-tensor-representative-calculus], g(P) the geometric representative and k the specified coefficient pullback iso [def-pur-scalar-pullback-representative-data]. Let t:f^{-1}(P tensor B_W) ~= f^{-1}P tensor B_Z be the ordinary monoidal tensor comparison followed by the coefficient iso from [lem-pur-scalar-sheaf-tensor-pullback]. Then the derived inverse-image tensor comparison at QP and B_W[0], followed by id tensor k, by g(P) tensor id, and by q_phi(f^{-1}P), equals derived inverse image of q_phi(P), followed by g(P tensor B_W) and Q(t). This is a counit compatibility, with no flatness or boundedness hypothesis.

proof.text: Specialize upperStar_single_tensor_representative to the ordinary scalar coefficient iso. The exact single-coefficient comparison equals the specified scalarCoefficientPullbackIso by its concrete definition. The endpoint equality isos in scalarTensorRepresentative become identity after unfolding the equal tensor functors. Cancel these identities and reassociate. The resulting equality is precisely the asserted scalar-endpoint square.

theorem scalarTensorRepresentative_pullback
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ W)
    (P : CochainComplex (Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) ℤ) :
    ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).app (scalarCoefficient φ W) ≫
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z).obj
          (L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))).map
          (scalarCoefficientPullbackIso φ f).hom ≫
        ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z).flip.obj (scalarCoefficient φ Z)).map
          (scalarGeometricRepresentative A f P) ≫
        scalarTensorRepresentative φ Z
          (((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
      L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).map (scalarTensorRepresentative φ W P) ≫
        scalarGeometricRepresentative A f
          (((tensorRight (scalarCoefficientSheaf φ W)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
              (upperStarTensorSingleIso A f (scalarCoefficientSheafPullbackIso φ f)) (.up ℤ) ≪≫
            (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso (Iso.refl
              (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f ⋙
                tensorRight (scalarCoefficientSheaf φ Z))) (.up ℤ)).symm).hom.app P)
